episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After a tragedy turns her world upside down, Jin Young-soon raises her son with the aim of steering him away from a life of hardship like hers.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Filled with childhood resentment, Choi Kang-ho navigates his career with ruthless ambition — later approaching Young-soon with a cruel motive.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A shocking accident leaves Kang-ho's outlook uncertain. Young-soon takes him home and seizes an opportunity for redemption.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Kang-ho recovers, he and Young-soon get closer. However, Young-soon later visits Seoul and witnesses unfavorable traces of Kang-ho's life.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After retuning home, Lee Mi-joo encounters Kang-ho in his new condition. Young-soon faces aggression from an unrelenting neighbor.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Kang-ho experiences a mysterious attack. Mi-joo finds an fortuitous business opportunity. The town convenes to rally against Young-soon.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Young-soon panics about the future after she receives scary news. Another sudden blow forces her to make hard decisions about herself and Kang-ho.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Young-soon pushes Kang-ho to the limits. She later finds a perplexing item from her son's old life. Mi-joo navigates her complex feelings around Kang-ho.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Young-soon and Kang-ho go through recollections of Kang-ho's past — discovering another side to his story.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Young-soon prepares Kang-ho for a safer future. After a startling incident, Mi-joo and Kang-ho share a tender moment — further complicating their lives.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: With Mi-joo by his side, Kang-ho finds out the truth after an alarming moment. Bang Sam-sik gets caught up in a dangerous situation.
